tools.description: Drift report across the homelab. Default scopes: argocd (apps not Synced+Healthy), externalsecrets (ExternalSecrets or ClusterSecretStores not Ready), vault (Vault paths ExternalSecrets read that are missing or deleted, and unreferenced ones), komodo (stacks down or missing files, pending ResourceSync), dns (technitium and pihole doctors in proxmox-infra; technitium needs a vault login), semaphore and pbs (their doctors). Opt-in: inventory (inventory-doctor) and terraform (lxc/talos/backup/vault drift-detect + unifi plan; slow, needs a vault login). Each check reports clean|drift|error|skipped. Reports only: fixes go through the repo skills.
